opportunities.name: Brush personal carry
opportunities.objective: Test brush personal carry against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Brushmaker grants Ivern's own attacks 0.2 AP magic damage for three seconds after leaving brush; Nashor and Dusk and Dawn emphasize that window. Rootcaller enables attack access and Triggerseed protects the approach; Daisy's independent slam supplies control rather than invented owner-item inheritance.
opportunities.requiredState: Keep brush access and root a target before personal attacks.
opportunities.failure: Ivern's jungle passive cannot make this a normal monster-attack farming build.
opportunities.test: Compare Ivern-only attack damage with Daisy commanded away.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Daisy is not assumed to carry Nashor, Rageblade or Spellblade from Ivern.

opportunities.name: Daisy siege amplifier
opportunities.objective: Test daisy siege amplifier against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Daisy's third consecutive attack on one champion/epic monster creates a 0.5 AP magic shockwave with a three-second limit; Triggerseed bursts for 0.8 AP. AP and Bloodletter support those magic packets, while Cosmic Drive helps Ivern stay close enough to command and shield her.
opportunities.requiredState: Daisy alive with a reachable repeated target and E available.
opportunities.failure: Pet kiting or target switches prevent the third-hit shockwave.
opportunities.test: Log Daisy attack/slam damage separately from E bursts and burn attribution.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Liandry and Bloodletter pet attribution need testing; helper data cannot establish every proc.

ruledOut.reason: Daisy is not assumed to carry Nashor, Rageblade or Spellblade from Ivern.

unknowns: Controlled current-patch proc testing remains necessary; source helper/statFormula expressions are evidence, not confirmed runtime behavior.

builds.name: Brush personal carry
builds.summary: Test brush personal carry against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test brush personal carry against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Brushmaker grants Ivern's own attacks 0.2 AP magic damage for three seconds after leaving brush; Nashor and Dusk and Dawn emphasize that window. Rootcaller enables attack access and Triggerseed protects the approach; Daisy's independent slam supplies control rather than invented owner-item inheritance.
testPlan: Required state: Keep brush access and root a target before personal attacks.
Compare Ivern-only attack damage with Daisy commanded away.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Ivern's jungle passive cannot make this a normal monster-attack farming build.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Daisy is not assumed to carry Nashor, Rageblade or Spellblade from Ivern.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Banshee's Veil, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
builds.author: ChatGPT

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: While in brush and for [3] seconds after leaving, Ivern's Attacks deal an additional [20 / 27.5 / 35 / 42.5 / 50 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage. Nearby allies will gain this effect for [1.5] seconds and deal [10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 + (0.1) × AP] magic damage.

Active: Ivern grows a patch of Brush, revealing the area for [8] seconds. The Brush persists until Ivern's team loses vision within it, or up to [45] seconds.

Ivern summons his sentinel friend Daisy to leap into the fray for [45] seconds.

Daisy, Slam!: Daisy's 3rd consecutive Attack on the same champion or epic monster will launch a shockwave, dealing [90 / 140 / 190 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage to all enemies hit as well as Knocking Up for [1] second. This effect can only occur once every [3] seconds.

Recast: Instruct Daisy to Attack or move.

Ivern conjures a vine dealing [80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage and Rooting the first enemy hit for [1.6 / 1.7 / 1.8 / 1.9 / 2] seconds. Allies that Attack a Rooted enemy dash into Attack Range. 

Recast: Ivern dashes directly onto the Rooted enemy.

Hitting non-epic monsters reduces {{ Spell_IvernQ_Name }}'s cooldown by 50%.

Ivern grants [75 / 115 / 155 / 195 / 235 + (0.5) × AP] Shield to an ally champion or Daisy. After [2] seconds, it bursts, dealing [70 / 90 / 110 / 130 / 150 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage and Slowing enemies by [(0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6) × 100]% for [2] seconds.

If Triggerseed detonates and no enemy champions are hit while the shield still persists, the ally will be shielded for [75 / 115 / 155 / 195 / 235 + (0.5) × AP] for [2] seconds.
